partners.mechanism_chain: RSPO1 (HGNC:10000) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP529); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP529) —LEADS_TO→ XX sex reversal (HP:0000837); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP529) —LEADS_TO→ Palmoplantar keratoderma (HP:0000965); RNF43 (HGNC:24401) —DISRUPTS→ Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP529); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP529) —LEADS_TO→ Predisposition to squamous cell carcinoma (HP:0031241); Wnt signaling pathway (WP:WP529) —LEADS_TO→ Sessile serrated polyposis (HP:0031243). Loss-of-function mutations in RSPO1 lead to dysregulation of the Wnt signaling pathway, resulting in XX sex reversal and palmoplantar keratoderma. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in RNF43 also dysregulate the Wnt signaling pathway, leading to sessile serrated polyposis and predisposition to squamous cell carcinoma. The convergence occurs at the level of the Wnt signaling pathway.
